# Mobile Phone Manager (MPM)

**Author:** BenQ Mobile GmbH & Co. OHG<br/>
**Platforms:** x65/x75 (SGOLD)

<img
  className="screenshot"
  src={require("./mobile-phone-manager/img/mobile-phone-manager.png").default}
  alt={"Mobile Phone Manager (MPM): screenshot 1"}
/>

The official application for managing BenQ-Siemens phones. It includes a file
manager, contact and calendar synchronization with Microsoft Outlook, data
backup and restore, messaging and multimedia features, as well as Mobile Modem Assistant for connecting a computer to the
internet through the phone.

The phone can be connected via USB, IrDA, or Bluetooth. This build fully
works with E71 and EL71.
